emerging_watch: Oil & Gas Producers (leader by score 1.215 but eligible=false, durability 0.19) — watching whether its durability_bar climbs back above 0.50 and it returns to eligible=true; if it does while holding the score lead over Big Banks, the rotation leadership becomes trend-backed and the Banks overweight should be re-reviewed. theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, shows a trend hurst_tag, full breadth (1.0), and high durability (0.80) — the one detector leg with validated drawdown-control value. It sits as the rotation challenger close behind Oil & Gas (margin 0.225) and lacks a crowding flag. This is a durable-stay-in-trend lean grounded in the gate discipline, not a momentum-alpha call.
theses.dissent: Financials lead in a narrowing rotation (eligible frac only 0.44) could already be late-stage; rank-IC ~0 means the leadership focus carries no forward return edge, and Canada's macro narrative is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics rather than a bank-supportive story.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Eligible under the trend gate with durability_bar=0.79, trend hurst_tag, and full breadth (1.0) — a defensive durable theme. theses.dissent: Crowding_z above 1.0 marks extended positioning; if the absolute-trend gate flips this theme to ineligible, the only validated defence is removed and any drawdown advantage is lost.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology ranks near the bottom (score -0.233, rank 13), is crowded (crowding_z=1.25), and shows mixed trend health despite being eligible. The detector's validated edge is avoiding shake-outs via the trend gate — a crowded, low-momentum, mixed-trend theme fails the staying-power test and offers no supported reason to hold.
theses.dissent: Macro narrative flow (unscheduled_share=1.0, dominant theme ai_tech) could reignite Tech upside independently of detector momentum — the avoid is conditional on detector trend health, not a prediction of negative returns.
